Align Delay.note: Utility device that delays incoming signals in samples, milliseconds, or meters/feet.

Color Limiter.note: Limiter with Saturation and Color controls, inspired by gritty hardware limiter sounds.

Envelope Follower.note: Turns an incoming signal's amplitude into a curve that modulates mapped parameters.

Envelope MIDI.note: Modulator device using an ADSR envelope to control up to eight mapped parameters.

Euclidean.note: MIDI generator creating Euclidean rhythm patterns for up to four voices.

Expression Control.note: Modulator controlling mapped parameters from MIDI and MPE sources like velocity, pressure and slide.

Expression Control Legacy.note: The Live 11 version of Expression Control, loaded in Sets made before Live 12.

LFO.note: Modulator device controlling mapped parameters using low-frequency oscillation.

MIDI Monitor.note: Utility MIDI device that displays incoming MIDI and MPE data.

MPE Control.note: Shapes incoming MPE data and can convert MPE signals to standard MIDI.

Note Echo.note: MIDI echo creating extra notes at timed intervals with decreasing velocity.

Shaper.note: Modulator device using a breakpoint envelope to generate mappable modulation data.

Shaper MIDI.note: Breakpoint-envelope modulator retriggered by each MIDI note and affected by velocity.

Velocity Shaper.note: MIDI transformation reshaping velocities of selected notes using an adjustable envelope.

DS Clang.note: Drum synth of two tones, noise and filter for cowbell and clave sounds.

DS Clap.note: Drum synth mixing filtered noise and an impulse through panned delay lines.

DS Cymbal.note: Drum synth combining sine and pulse waves with high-passed noise for cymbals.

DS FM.note: FM drum synth producing everything from static bursts to metallic lasers.

DS HH.note: Drum synth blending noise and sine waves for closed and open hi-hats.

DS Kick.note: Kick drum synth built on a modulated sine wave.

DS Sampler.note: Drum synth module built from your own loaded sample; deprecated since Live 12.

DS Snare.note: Drum synth of pitched oscillator and noise, from acoustic to gated electronic snares.

DS Tom.note: Drum synth combining an impulse with pitched oscillator waveforms to synthesize toms.
